title: AccountReviewSynthesis V3
description: The single semantic model response for Account Review V3. Metrics are referenced by content_id and bound later by the composer.

output_language.description: BCP-47 tag of the Creator-facing language from the isolated task context (for example en, zh-CN, pt-BR). Write every semantic string in this language; quoted native titles and proper nouns keep their own script. Fixed report labels use the Simplified Chinese template for zh/zh-CN/zh-SG/zh-Hans (CN/SG), and otherwise the English template; delivery may translate unmapped fixed labels without rewriting the analysis.

status.description: Completion status based on available data and task coverage.

headline.description: Short Creator-facing editorial headline in natural output_language, rendered unchanged. A single cumulative public snapshot supports sample distributions and associations, not historical change or its causes. State the finding within that boundary in this field itself; a later data-gap sentence cannot repair a causal title or diagnosis. Claim historical growth or a cause only when the supplied input contains independent temporal or causal evidence.

diagnosis.description: Single most important account diagnosis in natural output_language, rendered unchanged. A single cumulative public snapshot supports sample distributions and associations, not historical change or its causes. State the finding within that boundary in this field itself; a later data-gap sentence cannot repair a causal title or diagnosis. Claim historical growth or a cause only when the supplied input contains independent temporal or causal evidence.

what_works.description: Semantic winning patterns selected from analyzed content.

what_hurts.description: Semantic losing patterns selected from analyzed content.

recommendations.description: Next-cycle continue, stop, and test actions.

profile.description: Slim stable profile values; identity and schema metadata are injected by the composer. Window-specific cadence and ranking observations are not profile fields.

data_gaps.description: Creator-facing missing-data limitations in natural output_language. Preserve which claim is unverified and why; a gap note does not authorize a stronger headline or diagnosis.

pattern.description: Creator-facing report heading rendered unchanged. Name the pattern in natural creator language using output_language; express the analytical meaning in that language. Quoted native source titles and proper names keep their original wording in cited evidence.

explanation.description: Creator-facing explanatory prose rendered unchanged, using natural output_language. Explain why this observed pattern matters without upgrading sample association to historical change or its cause.

content_ids.description: Copy IDs character for character from this run's synthesis_input.content; verify the associated title. Never reconstruct IDs from titles, URLs or memory.

action.description: Concrete Creator-facing action in natural output_language, rendered unchanged. Proposed tests are recommendations, not verified outcomes.

success_metric.description: Optional measurable success criterion for a test, expressed in natural output_language without changing any supplied metric.
